---
applyTo: "**/*.smt2"
---
# SMT-LIB and Z3 requirements

- Document expected SAT/UNSAT status and the scope of each encoding.
- Inspect models or unsat cores when needed to justify a claim.
- Keep bounded encodings bounded; do not generalize a solver result.
- Record solver version, exact command, inputs, and observed result.
- Solver success is computational verification, not proof of originality or
  broad mathematical validity.
